transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because my mind is just constantly jumping around, and I can't seem to turn it off. It goes from worrying whether our lab's new partnership is going to end up cutting my position, to stressing over whether my data are wrong. And then I start thinking about my bills piling up, or how my family probably thinks I'm falling behind... and whether I've already ruined my chances at grad school. It's just a constant stream of all of that, all the time.
About how long have you been experiencing this constant stream of worries?

Um, I'd say it's been going on for about seven months now. It started right around the time the lab had a big funding shift. We brought in a new commercial partnership, and it just... it completely changed how everything was being run. So yeah, about seven months of this.
Alongside these worries, have you been feeling persistently down, depressed, or hopeless?

No, not really. I mean, I'm definitely stressed and overwhelmed by all the worrying, but I wouldn't say I feel depressed or hopeless. It's more just... I'm constantly on edge about everything that could go wrong, rather than feeling down about it, if that makes sense.
Do you find yourself performing repetitive actions or mental routines, like repeatedly checking things, to try to relieve these worries?

No, I don't really do anything like that. I don't have any rituals or, like, need to check the locks a certain number of times or anything. I just... I just sit there and worry about it. My brain just keeps spinning through all the bad scenarios, but I don't have any physical habits or routines I do to try and stop it.
Have you been having trouble with your sleep, such as difficulty falling or staying asleep?
Um, no, not really. I mean, I don't think so. I usually fall asleep okay, and I stay asleep through the night. It's more that when I'm awake, my mind is just racing. But my sleep itself seems fine.
Have you noticed any physical tension, such as tight or sore muscles, aches, or stiffness?

Yeah, actually, I have. My shoulders and neck stay really tight during the day. I'll just be sitting there, and I catch myself totally clenching my jaw while I'm looking over spreadsheets. By the time evening rolls around, I end up with these headaches and... just a lot of stiffness. It honestly feels like I've been carrying heavy equipment around all day, even when I haven't been.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating on your work, or does your mind ever go blank?

No, not really. I haven't noticed any issues with that. I mean, my mind is always going a mile a minute with all the worrying, but it never just goes blank. And when I'm at work, like if I'm setting up a test in the lab or something, I can focus on what I need to do just fine. So, no, concentration hasn't been a problem.
Have you been feeling easily fatigued or more tired than usual during the day?

Yeah, I definitely have. Even after a full night in bed, I wake up feeling like I've already pulled an all-nighter. It's just... by the time I'm at work labeling samples, or even later when I'm just trying to cook dinner for my family, my body feels really heavy. And my brain just feels completely drained. So, yes, I'm definitely a lot more tired than usual during the day.
Have you been feeling unusually irritable, snappy, or easily annoyed lately?

No, I wouldn't say so. I don't think I've been any more irritable or snappy than normal. I mean, I'm tired and stressed, but I don't really take it out on anyone else. So, no, I haven't noticed being easily annoyed.
Have you been feeling restless, keyed up, or like you're physically unable to sit still?

Yeah, actually, I do. Especially at work, I just feel really wound up. It's like I can't settle into my chair at all. I end up tapping my foot, checking my messages over and over... sometimes I even find myself getting up and walking back to the instrument room for absolutely no reason, just because I can't sit still. And I guess I'm pretty on edge, too, because even just normal lab noises keep startling me. So, yeah, definitely feeling restless.
